newsitem.title: UK: P&O stops taking trucks on UK/Bilbao route.
newsitem.headline: P&O stops taking trucks on UK/Bilbao route.

text.p: P&O European Ferries has stopped accepting commercial vehicles on its sailings to Bilbao due to the Spanish truckers strike, a spokeswoman told Reuters on Monday.
"We are not taking commercial vehicles at present, but we are in daily discussions to evaluate the situation," she said.
P&O took the action at the weekend, the spokeswoman said, because roads leading to Spain's northern ports were blocked.
However, she said passenger services remained unaffected with sailings between Portsmouth and Bilbao every Tuesday and Saturday.
"We will resume normal services as and when the strike ends or the situation changes," she said.
The UK ferry company is in direct contact with its commercial customers over the action, she added.
P&O European Ferries is part of the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co group.

Privately-owned Brittany Ferries, which also operates beteen the UK and Spain, said it was currently unaffected by the action as the vessel it operates between Plymouth and Santander is undergoing its annual refit, and would not re-enter service until early March.
